Pick **Lagoa/Campeche** for the best balance of lifestyle and reliability, as these areas offer the "sweet spot" of being walkable to cafes or surf and having reliable fiber internet [7].

**Lagoa/Campeche** — roughly **$800/month (R$ 4,420) as of July 2026** for a 1BR in the Lagoa core or Campeche [7] (using the exchange rate of 1 USD = 5.5167 BRL from Nov 9, 2026 [5]).

**Barra da Lagoa/Centro** — roughly **$550/month (R$ 3,044) as of July 2026** for a 1BR in the village or city center [7] (using the exchange rate of 1 USD = 5.5167 BRL from Nov 9, 2026 [5]).

**North/East** — general 1BR rent averages **R$ 3,000 - 5,000 per month (undated)** [2].

messages.content: Which neighborhoods in Florianópolis are best for a foreigner renting for six months? I want safe, walkable, near a beach, with fast internet.

The **North** and **East** zones offer the best balance for your requirements, depending on whether you prioritize resort-style amenities or a bohemian vibe [2].

**North** — best for resort-style living and infrastructure [2].
**East** — best for a bohemian, nature-focused, and surfing vibe [2].
**Central/South** — offers historic centers and calm villages, but lacks direct ocean beach access in some areas [2].
